name: AL-1095
summary: AL-1095, is a centrally acting stimulant drug with comparable effects to amphetamine, developed by Bristol in the 1970s.

pharmacology.text: AL-1095, is a centrally acting stimulant drug with comparable effects to amphetamine, developed by Bristol in the 1970s.

uses.text: AL-1095, is a centrally acting stimulant drug with comparable effects to amphetamine, developed by Bristol in the 1970s.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants with amphetamine-like effects can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety and loss of appetite.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。具有類安非他命作用的興奮劑可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、失眠、焦慮與食慾減退。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。具有类安非他命作用的兴奋剂可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、失眠、焦虑与食欲减退。

fact.en: AL-1095 was developed by the drug company Bristol in the 1970s as an amphetamine-like stimulant, but it never became a medicine.
fact.zh: AL-1095 是 Bristol 藥廠在 1970 年代開發的類安非他命興奮劑，但始終沒有成為藥物。
fact.zhHans: AL-1095 是 Bristol 药厂在 1970 年代开发的类安非他命兴奋剂，但始终没有成为药物。
